Who we serve

Reusable cocktail glassware and serveware for bars and nightclubs

Late service, crowded floors and wet hands are the conditions your glassware has to survive. Moulded one-piece construction removes the stem joint that fails first, and it protects your staff and your insurance as much as your stock.

Request a quoteBrowse the catalogue

What usually goes wrong

The five problems we hear most from this buyer type.

  • Breakage and glass-hazard liability during peak service
  • Glasses that cannot survive a bus tub or a stacked wash
  • Menus that need a signature serve customers photograph
  • Themed nights that need matching serveware fast
  • Replacement costs that quietly outrun the drinks margin

Serveware that keeps a signature serve looking like one

A cocktail programme lives on visual identity, and the vessel is most of it. The ribbed coupe presents a clarified cocktail like crystal; the margarita and martini shapes put the drink at the right height for a bar top; and the electroplated disco ball cup turns any pour into a mirror-finish photograph that guests post without being asked.

For themed nights, we carry the pieces that define an offer — a 21.6 oz beer bat, cowboy boot glasses, 50-caliber and 12-gauge shot sets, and LED shot glasses that light a tray of twelve. These are the items that justify a premium price and get reordered for the next themed weekend.

Built to survive a real bar

One-piece moulding means there is no stem joint to snap when a glass goes into a bus tub at speed. The beer mug range uses heavier base walls and reinforced handles so it feels substantial in the hand and survives commercial stacking. Everything in the range is reusable and designed for repeat washing rather than single use.

For bottle service, the double-wall 8 L cooler holds ice through a full dinner service, and the LED ice buckets add rechargeable illumination to make a bottle presentation visible across a dark room without installing anything.

House branding on the serveware

A logo on the glass is one of the most cost-effective permanent advertising options a venue can buy, and it also makes stock harder to lose. Pad printing, laser engraving and electroplating are available, and custom colour matching lets you run a house colour across the whole glassware set rather than just the signage.

Reusable cocktail glassware and serveware for bars and nightclubs — questions

Will plastic cocktail glasses look cheap to my customers?

Ribbed and coupe shapes in PS or acrylic read as premium glassware in service, especially in low light. Where the venue needs the closest match to crystal, the Tritan and acrylic options have the rim thinness and clarity that guests notice.

What is the most durable option for a high-volume bar?

Tritan is the most impact-resistant material in the range and is safe in a commercial dishwasher. PP is the next best choice for repeated hot washing.

Do you sell LED ice buckets?

Yes. The LED range covers 4 L, 8 L and 12 L buckets with rechargeable 1,000 mAh batteries and a charger, in white or yellow illumination.

Can we get a whole glassware set in our house colour?

Yes. Colour matching to Pantone is available across all moulded lines so the entire set can be produced in one house colour.

How fast can you supply for a themed event?

FOB dispatch is confirmed per SKU and depends on stock status, quantity and whether custom colour or printing is involved. — tell us the date and we will confirm feasibility in writing.

How do we replace individual pieces without reordering the full range?

Replacement is quoted against the same SKU and the same approved brief. Send the SKU list and the quantities, and the minimum for a replacement order is confirmed for those models.

Request a quote

Can the serveware be branded for a venue menu?

Branding is confirmed from the selected piece, the artwork, the decoration area and the quantity. Send the menu or the logo and the intended location on the item for a feasibility review.
